Dangerous Goods

Caisse en plastique

A rigid plastic box used for the storage and transport of dangerous goods, offering lightweight protection and chemical resistance.

Why it matters

Caisse en plastique matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Caisse en plastique?

In this glossary, Caisse en plastique refers to: A rigid plastic box used for the storage and transport of dangerous goods, offering lightweight protection and chemical resistance.

How is Caisse en plastique used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Les caisses en plastique sont choisies pour certaines expéditions de marchandises dangereuses en raison de leur résistance à la corrosion et de leur facilité de nettoyage."

Why does Caisse en plastique matter in logistics?

Caisse en plastique matters because it supports clear communication in Dangerous Goods contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Caisse en plastique?

Caisse en plastique is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Caisse en plastique belong to?

In this glossary, Caisse en plastique is grouped under Dangerous Goods. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A rigid plastic box used for the storage and transport of dangerous goods, offering lightweight protection and chemical resistance.

Operational example

Plastic crates are selected for certain dangerous goods shipments due to their resistance to corrosion and ease of cleaning.

Localized term

Caisse en plastique

Localized example

Les caisses en plastique sont choisies pour certaines expéditions de marchandises dangereuses en raison de leur résistance à la corrosion et de leur facilité de nettoyage.
